hero.eyebrow: Quarried in Egypt · Cut for the world
hero.text: GMG sources, cuts, and finishes natural marble and granite for architects and developers who won't compromise on material honesty.

about.subtitle: CURATED LIVING, QUIETLY LUXURIOUS.
about.title: About GMG
about.p1: GMG is a design studio rooted in a love of timeless interiors and considered details. We create elegant spaces that balance beauty, functionality, and emotion.
about.p2: With years of experience, we transform ideas into refined environments tailored to every client.

step1.title: Marble is taken from the quarry
step1.desc: Large marble blocks are carefully cut from the quarry using diamond wire.

step2.title: Blocks are cut into slabs
step2.desc: The large blocks are cut into marble slabs and numbered to keep the natural pattern in order.

step3.title: Slabs are polished
step3.desc: Each slab is polished or finished to get the right look, texture, and shine.

step4.title: Marble is installed on-site
step4.desc: Our team installs the marble directly on-site, from floors and lobbies to walls and facades.
